policy.resampling: nearest-neighbor; same source transform for1024 and256 exports
policy.alpha: Preserved; threshold32 is for bounds only. Faint surrounding alpha is never keyed or thresholded on transparent images.
policy.baseline: Centered in both axes, not aligned to a common floor; chosen to make canvas position consistent.
policy.sourceSelection: Latest neutral proposal, else existing plain-idle, else existing idle, else gray-keyed first seed cell.
policy.originals: Unchanged. No live sprite, mood, runtime metadata, generated latest alias, or gallery edited.
policy.private: Claude Bot and requested Skill Scout variant exported only to local folder; no private absolute source paths in manifest.
